This PR replaces the LLM slug-generator prompt truncation with `truncateUtf16Safe` and adds a focused regression test for an emoji split at the 2000-code-unit boundary.

PR surface: Source +1, Tests +14. Total +15 across 2 files.

Reproducibility: yes. from source: current `main` slices `sessionContent` by raw UTF-16 code units before interpolating it into the slug-generation prompt. A string with 1999 BMP code units followed by an emoji can leave a lone surrogate, though I did not run a live current-main slug-generator repro.
